items.title: Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services
items.summary: Try Amazon ECS Gateway, a new account-level resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized workloads by dynamically provisioning and managing the necessary infrastructure on your behalf, with all resources created directly in your account.

items.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
items.summary: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.
items.title_ja: 8つのeMudhra証明書が侵害されています。知っておくべきことをご案内します
items.overview: 8つのeMudhra中間証明書が弱いキーを使用していることが判明した後、Cloudflareは軽減策を展開し、クライアントの更新をリリースしています。影響、当社の対応、顧客と開発者が次にすべきことを説明します。
